statement: For the four phase-+1 stabilizer generator triples frozen in source.md, both existential assertions E_5 and E_6 are false. Explicitly, there is no permutation pi in Sym(5) and no one-qubit unitaries U_1,...,U_5 such that (tensor_i U_i) P_pi Q(S_A)=Q(S_B), and there is no permutation pi in Sym(6) and no one-qubit unitaries U_1,...,U_6 such that (tensor_i U_i) P_pi Q(S_+)=Q(S_-).
contribution: This resolves both concrete pairs in Mahmoud's Question 5.4 by explicitly applying the prior-art marginal/support-subcode local-unitary invariant. Exact signed Pauli projector tables and direct partial traces give two small permutation obstructions: the two exceptional rank-4 triples intersect in 1 versus 2 coordinates for the five-qubit pair, while the four-subsystem rank histograms are {8:3,16:12} versus {4:1,16:14} for the six-qubit pair. No invention of the general invariant or resolution of Mahmoud's broader question is claimed.
